verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair privacy question for a desktop and web email client, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never mentions a telemetry, usage-tracking or analytics opt-out setting. The action logging and analytics/reporting features are audit and reporting capabilities, not user-facing tracking controls, and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
